rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides complete HubSpot CRM integration with multi-transport support (HTTP, streaming HTTP, and STDIO), built by Sanket Kasar using Node.js with comprehensive session management, rate limiting, and Docker deployment capabilities. The implementation offers 15+ tools for managing contacts, companies, deals, and associations, plus 8+ resources for accessing CRM data and properties, with 5+ specialized prompts for pipeline analysis and lead scoring workflows. Features include production-ready security hardening, multi-architecture Docker builds with CI/CD automation, Kubernetes deployment configurations, and extensive monitoring with structured logging and metrics collection, making it valuable for businesses integrating AI workflows with HubSpot data, developers building CRM-powered applications, or organizations needing scalable HubSpot API access with enterprise-grade reliability and observability.
